title: Negative Object Presence Evaluation (NOPE) to Measure Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Vision-Language models on negative pronoun (NegP) visual questions across different question categories (e.g., color, counting, location, person) to identify the models' over-reliance on text-based answer distributions and unimodal priors rather than actual visual grounding.

Analyzing object hallucination rates based on the semantic relevance of the queried non-existent object to the visual scene (e.g., closely related vs. unrelated) to demonstrate the models' over-reliance on learned object co-occurrence statistics and contextual priors.
